# Blue Thunder Technologies

> > Blue Thunder Technologies provides cleanroom consumables including USP <797>/<800> compliant sterile wipes, Class 100 cleanroom gloves, and presaturated IPA wipes for pharmaceutical, healthcare, and controlled environment applications.

Blue Thunder Technologies specializes in contamination control products for cleanrooms, compounding pharmacies, and healthcare facilities. Their product line includes TechNiGlove cleanroom gloves, FREE-SAT and blu-SAT presaturated wipes, PHARMA-GLOVE sterile gloves, and HYPO-CHLOR disinfection wipes, all designed to meet ISO Class 5/6 and USP standards.

## Key Topics

- USP <797> and USP <800> Compliance
- ISO Class 5 and ISO Class 6 Cleanrooms
- Class 100 Cleanroom Standards
- Sterile Wipes and Presaturated Wipes
- Nitrile Gloves (Powder-Free)
- IPA (Isopropyl Alcohol) Solutions
- DI Water (Deionized Water)
- TechNiGlove Product Line
- Poly-Cellulose and Polyester Wipes
- Chemo-Approved and Fentanyl-Resistant Gloves
- ASTM D6978 Testing Standards
- Sensitive Skin and LOW DERMA Technology
- Sodium Hypochlorite Disinfection
- Aseptic Compounding Supplies
- FDA CFR Title 21 Compliance
